faq.q: What does the product URL provide?
faq.a: A readable public page supplies its main product image and name as the starting reference.
Use a public page that loads without sign-in and shows the variant you sell.

faq.q: What if the page cannot be read?
faq.a: Upload the product photo directly when the page blocks access or has no usable image.

faq.q: Can I change the captured image?
faq.a: Yes. Replace it with your own upload before generation.

faq.q: Does the URL include prices or reviews?
faq.a: No. The tool uses the product image and name; add current prices or reviews in your editor.

faq.q: How long can the video be?
Can I use the clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use the download in TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or other ad placements.
